title: Return Tide
summary: 5-panel page. Opening image: Opening montage across six separate inland interiors: phones glow beside Matt’s municipal console, Ryan’s marine workbench, Chris’s cable-cluttered desk, Justin’s climbing bag, Nicole’s kitchen table and Kevin’s forecast workstation. Final image: Ryan pauses at his marine workbench with a wrench in one hand and the group message open in the other; he reads it, locks the phone and sets it face-down without replying.
panelPlan: Opening montage across six separate inland interiors: phones glow beside Matt’s municipal console, Ryan’s marine workbench, Chris’s cable-cluttered desk, Justin’s climbing bag, Nicole’s kitchen table and Kevin’s forecast workstation.
Close sequence of runner-chat screens on different phones repeating LOWEST WINDOW OF THE YEAR and DEEP SECTOR MAYBE WALKABLE over maps and tide graphics.
Kevin sits forward at his workstation with wind and pressure layers stacked over the extreme-low tide chart; one hand braces his chin while he frowns at the mismatch.
Justin stands beside his packed rope bag typing into the group chat with one thumb, a crooked grin on his face as his joke appears on screen.
Ryan pauses at his marine workbench with a wrench in one hand and the group message open in the other; he reads it, locks the phone and sets it face-down without replying.

dialogueInline.speaker: Kevin Marsh
dialogueInline.text: Wind doesn’t match the pretty version.

dialogueInline.speaker: Justin Rourke
dialogueInline.text: You coming or writing a report?
